conversion: topojson-client@3.1.0 feature(world, world.objects.features); coordinates rounded to 2 decimal places
validation: D3 geoArea: all features below 2*pi steradians; CHN correctly contains [116.4,39.9]; original winding preserved.
notes: Use d3.geoOrthographic or another d3-geo projection; do not draw longitude/latitude as Cartesian canvas coordinates.
Natural Earth uses de facto borders by default. Boundaries are generalized at 110m scale and omit many small islands.
177 polygon features are not a complete inventory of all sovereign states or territories.
France geometry includes distant territories: computed country centroid may not be a sensible camera location.
Russia/Fiji/Antarctica contain antimeridian features: let d3-geo perform spherical clipping rather than connecting raw planar vertices.
GeoJSON properties.id is the atlas's adm0A3 identifier; usually ISO3. Preserve it as a string without numerical conversion.
